description: Weekly dependency updates, only to versions published at least 30 days ago (the same age pnpm-workspace.yaml installs from: minimumReleaseAge 43200 minutes), security fixes included. The weekly audit job (.github/workflows/audit.yml) catches advisories Renovate cannot fix, e.g. in transitive dependencies.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for every stable minor/patch update. 0.x minors can break, so they keep their own PRs.
Electron ships the whole runtime: its own PR, verified with the e2e suite and a packaged-app smoke test.
Native modules are rebuilt against Electron's ABI: their own PR.

Expo SDK (mobile app): an SDK pins the versions of its expo-* modules, React Native and the native libraries it was tested with, so they move together in one PR, approved from the Dependency Dashboard. Each bump is a new native build (expo prebuild --clean). The mobile app's react is here too: React Native's renderer is built for one React minor, so react moves only with the SDK.

Patched in patches/ (package.json pnpm.patchedDependencies, keyed by exact version): a bump needs the patch re-ported, so approve it from the Dependency Dashboard. electron-builder is here because it pins the patched app-builder-lib. Kept out of the weekly non-major group, which would otherwise need approval as a whole.
TypeScript and React are exempt from the minimum release age (pnpm-workspace.yaml minimumReleaseAgeExclude): always the latest version.
